learning_outcomes.text: Students will calculate the time value of monetary transactions.
Students will perform economic comparison of alternative investments.
Students will conduct cost analysis in power generation systems.
To have the ability to perform transportation cost analysis in ships.
Students will perform cost analysis in shipbuilding.

syllabus_topics: Introduction and Objectives of Engineering Economics
Relationships between present and future values of different cash flow profiles
Methods for measuring the economic value of investments
Cost analysis in power generation systems
Present Worth Method and Annual Worth Method
Future Worth Method Payback Period Method
Cost Analysis in Power Generation Systems
Annual Fuel and Operation-Maintenance Cost Calculation Methods
Cost Analysis in Ship Operation, Application of Different Cost Analysis Methods in Ship Operation
Study of the Effects of Operating Parameters on Cost in Ships / Examples of Engineering Economics Applications in Shipbuilding Engineering
bibliography: White J.A., Agee M.H., Case K.E., “Principles of Engineering Economic Analysis”, John Wiley, 1989.
Aybers N., Şahin B., “Enerji Maliyeti”, YTÜ Yayını, 1995.
Riggs J.L., West T.M., “Essentials of Engineering Economics”, McGraw-Hill, 1986.
Okka O. “Mühendislik Ekonomisi”, Nobel Yayın Dağıtım.
